products.name: Autumn Harvest Wood Flower Cornucopia Arrangement
products.description: Bring the warmth of fall indoors with this handcrafted wood flower arrangement featuring rich burgundy, burnt orange and golden yellow tones accented with greenery, raffia and autumn-inspired details. Designed as a lasting alternative to fresh flowers, this one-of-a-kind arrangement adds a cozy seasonal touch to a dining table, entryway, mantel or fall display. Handcrafted by A Pretty Little Life. Only one available.
